title: Enforce run.budgets: pause with a budget kind before a round

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Budgets are stored but never checked. The budget is copied into run.json at setup (internal/engine/engine.go:186), and each role's tokens are saved (internal/engine/round.go:252). Nothing compares them with the limit, so a slice never pauses on a budget.
The design says it should. When a limit is reached, the running role finishes and the slice pauses before the next role starts (docs/design.md:521-527). The dashboard already lists budget pauses under Needs you (docs/dashboard.md:98). No budget pause kind exists yet (internal/runrec/record.go:121-125).
The limits are minutes and tokens (internal/registry/registry.go:28-33).
Open: run.budget-resume (adj check: not found). Ask: what does retry do after a budget pause, and does DefaultMaxRounds stay (internal/engine/engine.go:24; docs/design.md:256-258)? Also ask which minutes clock applies: CreatedAt (record.go:189) or the sum of role times, and whether paused time counts.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- internal/runrec/record.go:121-125: add PendingBudget = "budget" to the pending kinds (proposed name).
- internal/engine/round.go:142-150 (runRound start): the budget check goes here, before the brief. New helper overBudget (proposed) placed just above runRound.
- internal/engine/round.go:252: tokens are already saved per role. No change expected.
- internal/engine/engine.go:186: budgets are copied at setup. No change expected.
- internal/engine/engine.go:318-340 (Retry): the resume rule for a budget pause (Open run.budget-resume).
- internal/engine/round.go:121-136 (pendingSection): a budget pause adds no brief section. Check only.
- internal/registry/registry.go:28-33: Budgets. No change expected.
- internal/daemon/runs.go:434-447: the status passes the pending kind through; the switch at 445 must handle "budget".
- internal/source/source.go:181: paused already counts as needs-you. No change expected.
- internal/tui/pane.go:95-104: the pane footer for a paused run shows the budget reason.
- Tests: internal/engine/budget_test.go (new); internal/tui/engine_runs_test.go (budget row); internal/runrec/runrec_test.go (kind round-trip).
- Docs: docs/design.md:255-259 (MaxRounds note) and 521-527 (Budgets). docs/dashboard.md:98 already lists budget pauses. docs/state.md:44 and 98 show the budgets example. No change expected there.
- Goldens: only if a row text changes.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestBudgetTokensPauseBeforeTheNextRole: a role's tokens pass the limit; the next role does not start; state is paused; Pending.Kind is "budget"; Pending.State is the state the next role would enter.
- TestBudgetMinutesPauseBeforeTheNextRole: a fake clock past the minutes limit pauses before the next role (fakeClock, internal/engine/harness_test.go:44-49).
- TestBudgetLetsTheRunningRoleFinish: the role that crosses the limit finishes, and its record is saved, before the pause.
- TestZeroBudgetNeverPauses: an unset budget never pauses.
- TestBudgetPauseIsNeedsYou: the budget pause counts under Needs you (source.go:181), and the pane shows the reason.
- TestRoundLimitStillStopsARedLoop (internal/engine/engine_test.go:410) is unchanged.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first in internal/engine/budget_test.go (new). Use newHarness (internal/engine/harness_test.go:190) and set the budget through its options.
2. Add PendingBudget = "budget" in internal/runrec/record.go:121-125 (proposed name).
3. Add overBudget(rec runrec.Record) (string, bool) (proposed name) above runRound (round.go:142). Tokens are the sum of rec.Roles[i].Tokens (record.go:59). Minutes are e.d.now() minus rec.CreatedAt (record.go:189), checked only when Budgets.Minutes > 0.
4. At the top of runRound (round.go:142), after the snapshot at :143: if over budget, return outcome{}, e.pause(runrec.Pending{Kind: runrec.PendingBudget, State: r.state, Role: r.role, Round: r.n, Reason: why}).
5. The check runs before each role round, so no running role is killed (design.md:524-526). The ledger step is not started when the check pauses.
6. Leave Retry (engine.go:318-340) as it is until the Open question is answered.
7. internal/daemon/runs.go:445: the status switch passes the budget pause through. Add a test; no code change expected.
8. internal/tui/pane.go:95-104: make sure the reason line shows the budget text (TestBudgetPauseIsNeedsYou).
9. Docs: docs/design.md:521-527 (name the minutes clock and the budget pause kind) and 256-258 (MaxRounds wording, after the Open answer).
10. Run the checks in Check.md.
Open:
- run.budget-resume (Why.md): what retry does after a budget pause; whether MaxRounds stays; the minutes clock; whether paused time counts.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/runrec ./internal/tui ./internal/daemon ./internal/registry
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .   (expect no output)
- go test ./internal/tui -update only if a golden row changed; then review the diff in testdata/golden/
- rg -n "PendingBudget|budget" internal   (the new kind needs a consumer and a test)
- slicer check
- adj lint
- Tests use the fake runner and fake clock. No live vendor call.
